mapper.select:
SELECT ir.id, ir.order_id as orderId, ir.amount, ir.type, ir.payment_method as paymentMethod, ir.remark, ir.payment_time as paymentTime, ir.operator_id as operatorId, e.real_name as operatorName, ir.create_time as createTime FROM income_record ir LEFT JOIN employee e ON ir.operator_id = e.id
AND ir.type = #{type}
AND ir.payment_time >= DATE(#{startDate, jdbcType=DATE})
AND ir.payment_time < DATE_ADD(DATE(#{endDate, jdbcType=DATE}), INTERVAL 1 DAY)
ORDER BY ir.payment_time DESC
